success.title: Upload Max Size Optimal
success.details: Your site's upload max size is set to {current_value}, which is optimal for handling file uploads.

error.title: Upload Max Size Needs Attention
error.details: Your site's upload max size is set to {current_value}. We recommend increasing it to at least {recommended_value} for better file handling.
steps: Contact your hosting provider about increasing upload max size
Ensure post_max_size is larger than upload_max_filesize

learn_more.description: Upload max size determines the maximum size of individual files that can be uploaded to your site. This affects media uploads, plugin installations, and theme uploads.
recommendations: Set upload max size to at least 40M
